name: jarvis
description: Local AI Coding IDE — Offline, GGUF-powered, OpenCode-inspired
author: Benz Siangco

scripts.install:all: cd app/frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && bun install
scripts.build:backend: cd app/backend && bun build --compile --windows-hide-console --windows-title="Jarvis Backend" --windows-publisher="Benz Siangco" --outfile=../../dist/backend/server server.js
scripts.prep:tauri: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && node app/tauri/scripts/prepare.mjs
scripts.build: npm run prep:tauri && cd app/tauri && npx tauri build
